recent.report: NEXUS.md was already filled in, with no placeholders and no 'drafted' todo, so I changed nothing and made no commit. - **What it is:** Forever Forge, a theorycrafting and build site for WoW: Forever at wow-forever-forge.com. It has a talent calculator and diffs, an item database, and a gear sandbox. The stack is Vite + TypeScript, Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1, and a Python data pipeline. -
